MainWindow.cs:364 and both fresh About captures instruct checking updates, downloading the installer, disconnecting VPN, closing BorisRay and running Setup while retaining subscription/rules. The copy wraps readably at both widths. Transfers.cs:84 prefers installer_url. Scripts/installer.iss declares Program Files installation, Start menu and optional desktop shortcuts, normal uninstall and no LocalAppData deletion; saved installer checks corroborate the tested lifecycle.

Source still retains pending state until successful StartAsync. Inspected compact Applications/Sites running fixtures show saved/reconnect guidance plus Apply routes above the tables. Their title bars state that running UI is simulated without a network connection.
